name: pagetagger
description: Mark live webpages, organize page-aware projects, and export evidence locally.
author: DEV THAKUR

scripts.extension:check: node --check extension/src/background/service-worker.js && node --check extension/src/content/annotaura-content.js && node --check extension/src/workspace/workspace.js && node --check extension/src/workspace/scratch.js
scripts.extension:package: pnpm extension:verify && cd extension/dist/chromium && zip -qr ../annotaura-chromium.zip . && cd ../firefox && zip -qr ../annotaura-firefox.zip .
